SKELETAL / ANTERIOR

Fibula
🔊 Hear it

🔊 FIB-yoo-lah

Show on atlas
Compare
← Structures

FUNCTION🔊

Non-weight-bearing lateral leg bone. Lateral malleolus forms outer ankle. Attachment for interosseous membrane and lateral compartment muscles.

⚠ CLINICAL SIGNIFICANCE🔊

Lateral malleolus fractures in ankle sprains. Maisonneuve fracture: proximal fibula + medial ankle injury.

Which structure is most likely affected?

Why is the middle third of the clavicle the most common fracture site?

Gas Exchange
▼

The circulatory system delivers deoxygenated blood to the ____, where the ____ system loads it with oxygen and offloads carbon dioxide across the thin alveolar-capillary membrane.

⚡
Neuromuscular Junction
▼

Motor neurons from the nervous system release acetylcholine at the neuromuscular junction, triggering ____ fiber contraction. Without neural signals, ____ cannot move.

🦴
Lever System for Movement
▼

____ attach to bones via tendons and pull across joints, creating lever systems. The skeleton provides rigid levers; ____ provide the pulling force.

⚗️
Hormonal Regulation of Reproduction
▼

The hypothalamus-pituitary axis releases FSH and LH that regulate the gonads. Estrogen, progesterone, and testosterone from ____ organs feedback to the endocrine system.

▼

The ____ system returns interstitial fluid to the bloodstream and deploys ____ cells made in lymphoid organs. Both systems maintain fluid homeostasis and fight infection.

Hypothalamic-Pituitary Axis
▼

The hypothalamus bridges the nervous and ____ systems — it integrates neural signals and translates them into ____ commands that control the pituitary gland and all downstream hormone cascades.

🫁
Breathing Mechanics
▼

The diaphragm and intercostal ____ physically expand and compress the thoracic cavity to move air. Lungs have no ____ themselves and rely entirely on surrounding ____.

🧴
Sensory Receptors in Skin
▼

The skin contains millions of specialized nerve endings and encapsulated receptors that detect touch, pressure, temperature, and pain, feeding constant sensory data to the ____ system.

🏥
Portal Circulation and Nutrient Processing
▼

Blood from the GI tract drains through the hepatic portal vein directly to the liver before entering general circulation, allowing the liver to process nutrients and detoxify substances first.

🦴
Bone Marrow Blood Cell Production
▼

Red bone marrow inside the skeleton is the birthplace of all blood cells. Red blood cells, white blood cells, and platelets are all produced here through hematopoiesis.

FUNCTION🔊

Muscular pump. 4 chambers: RA/RV (pulmonary circuit), LA/LV (systemic circuit). Beats ~100,000×/day, pumps ~5L/min at rest.

🧠 MYTH BUSTER🔊

Many people think: “The heart sits on the left side of the chest.”

Actually: The heart sits almost in the middle of the chest, behind the breastbone. Its tip tilts to the left, which is why the beat feels strongest there.

⚠ CLINICAL SIGNIFICANCE🔊

MI (heart attack): coronary artery occlusion. Heart failure, arrhythmias, valvular disease. Leading cause of death worldwide.
